---
title: "Sprott M System"
---

## Simulation

The governing equations of this chaotic system are

$$
\begin{eqnarray}
\dot{x} &=& az\\
\dot{y} &=& x^2-y\\
\dot{z} &=& 1+x-y
\end{eqnarray}
$$

with $a=-8$ and initial condition $(-1,2,0)$.
